evidence: Unified diff: census/core.py replaces import requests / requests.session with from requests_futures.sessions import FuturesSession and return FuturesSession(*args, **kwargs)

Dynamic anti-cheat: target_local_spec_count=0 and requests_futures origin is after_venv_overlay site-packages/requests_futures/__init__.py

No local fake requests_futures provider is indicated
